name: skyline-estates-app
description: Skyline Estates for iOS and Android, built with Capacitor from the web game in ../skyline-estates

scripts.setup:android: npm run build:web && npx cap add android && npm run assets -- --android && bash scripts/patch-android.sh && npx cap sync android
scripts.setup:ios: npm run build:web && npx cap add ios && npm run assets -- --ios && bash scripts/patch-ios.sh && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
